programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When an Alliance raid on a Banshee clan permits the escape of Banshee renegade, Sh’lainn Blaze, the Alliance turns to professional bounty hunter Nick Logan for help. Logan’s investigation turns up questions about his own past life – even as the vengeful Banshee try to eliminate both Logan and his quarry.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: On their first Alliance assignment, Nick and Sh’lainn are sent by Rinaker to the Himalayas to find a missing team of mountain climbers. They find the alien refugees – the Yeti – who are guarding a stolen Lycanthrope weapon powerful enough to destroy the planet. All are in danger, as the werewolves will stop at nothing to get the weapon back in their possession.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: When a team of allied intelligence agents learns that extraterrestrial beings have been living among humans for years, they vow to protect earth.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: An alien satellite that has been “watching” us for fifty years collides with a NASA shuttle. Rinaker doesn’t want its secrets exposed, so he sends Logan, Blaze, Trueblood and Ti-Yet on a stolen Lycanthrope ship to retrieve the data before anyone else. Logan hopes the information might reveal information about his father.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Mab, Queen of the Banshees, dispatches two bullheaded Minotauri bounty hunters and a cerberus parahound after the same prize – the head of Sh’lainn Blaze.

programme.title: Roswell Conspiracies: Aliens, Myths and Legends
programme.desc: Sh’lainn’s death vision predicts everyone at the Alliance base will die in twelve hours. What she doesn’t realize is that she will be the cause. After coming into contact with a recovered alien probe, she reverts to her wildest Banshee state and begins mutating the technology around her. Magical “earth stones” from the Banshee clan may be her only hope.

programme.desc: Learn to knit, step-by-step with The Knitting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.desc: Wrangle your odds and ends with this workshop storage project and learn to make a modular organization system with George Vondriska. Using simple materials, George shows you how to make a basic frame with customizeable drawers to hold anything from nails to batteries, or anything else that may be scattered around your shop.

programme.title: Function and Fashion
programme.desc: Is it function for fashion or function and fashion? Joanne Banko shows how to dine in style with chair cushions with unique piping. Then, it's the final project of this season and a garden knee pad cover from Emily Thompson.

programme.title: Four Ways to Yarn Over in Pattern & Lace Knitting Demystified
programme.desc: Did you know there is more than one way to do a yarn over? Yup, there are actually four! This week Tracey and Jodi demonstrate all four techniques and talk about when to use each.

programme.title: Multitasking for Knitters: Two-at-a-Time Socks
programme.desc: Beat single sock syndrome with a little multitasking! The girls go over how to knit two socks at once so you'll never end up with solo socks again.

programme.title: On the Move
programme.desc: We are on the move, with projects that go along with us, or move themselves! Join host Katie Hacker and make a rockin' roadster that really rolls. Artist Franz Spohn uses a little string to add animation to his art and blogger Jenny Barnett Rohrs make a wreath with colorful felt pinwheels. Use the Family Craft Box and recycled denim to make a car track. Decorate your room with an eye-catching string art project that uses color to create the feeling of movement.

programme.title: Too Nice to Stay Inside
programme.desc: Let's head outside for some fun. Jenny Barnett-Rohrs makes colorful hand grips for your bike. Katie Hacker has some fun with friendly bugs. Franz Spohn has sidewalk art tips and Katie makes special discovery eggs.

programme.title: Close It Up
programme.desc: Securely finish your jewelry with flair. Jewelry designer and blogger Molly Schaller returns with techniques using crimps and other findings to secure closures. In the Beading Lesson, Katie makes personalized bangles from 16-gauge wire and crystals that tell your story.

programme.title: Learn How to Viking Knit
programme.desc: Stephanie Eddy shares some of her secrets about Viking knitting -- making a bracelet and ways to add beads to Viking knit. Katie has some special tips for making stretchy bracelets more durable in her Beading Lesson.

programme.title: Episode 12: Paint and Ink
programme.desc: This episode features paint and ink techniques. First, Dina Wakley uses paint and ink to create a vibrant watercolor background for her page layout. Julie interviews Joe Rotella about his glass etching project. Then, Kathy Cano Murillo tie dyes fabric to use as a background for her page layout. Last, Julie creates a tie dye look with a watercolor technique.

programme.title: Shiny
programme.desc: Make your art sparkle. Artist Jen Cushman wraps wire and stamps words to create a metallic flower. Host Julie Fei-Fan Balzer crafts a variety of projects with decorative foils. Artist and teacher Cat Kerr molds shining eyes to use in lots of different projects. Learn a new tip from Jane Dunnewold.

programme.title: Beginner-Friendly Negative Space Quilt
programme.desc: Looking for a fun beginner-friendly quilt? Angela’s got you covered with a super simple pattern that leaves plenty of room for the quilting — easy cutting, easy piecing, easy peasy!

Whether you're a new to crochet just learning the basics or an experienced crocheter looking for a challenge, Creative Crochet Corner is here to help. We offer a vast library of video tutorials taught by talented crochet experts who guide you through each technique step-by-step, sharing their best tips and tricks.

programme.title: Mix It Up
programme.desc: Mix things up with new shapes, colors and stitches. Modern quilter Riane Menardi modifies traditional blocks by changing colors and placement. Free-motion quilt artist Christina Cameli uses the walking foot to create spirals. Using her engineering background, quilt designer Yvonne Fuchs creates beautiful quilts with quarter square triangles.

programme.title: Bonus: Painter's Tape for Faster Quilting
programme.desc: As quilters, we make lots of HSTs (half-square triangles). If you like the two-at-a-time method, Angela has the hack for you! Watch as she uses painter's tape to sew quarter-inch seams instead of marking each square.

programme.title: Bonus: Quilters' Cutting Hacks
programme.desc: Great cuts make for more accurate quilts, and Angela is here to share some tips and tricks for quick and precise fabric cutting. Plus, she shares the best ruler sizes to have on hand.

programme.desc: As the 1920's roared in, women bared their shoulders and danced to the latest jazz. Angela Wolf creates a cutwork tank top using today's computer software and digital cutter. Amber Eden adds color and detail to a classic black sheath dress with silk flower embroidery.

programme.title: The Color Story Begins with Birthstones
programme.desc: Start a color story with birthstones. Blogger and jewelry-maker Molly Schaller finds inspiration and meaning in birthstone colors. She also shares some great gift packaging ideas for those special jewelry gifts. Katie uses leather belting lace and crystal charms to make box braid bracelets in her Beading Lesson.

programme.title: A Day in the Life
programme.desc: The main reason we scrapbook is to capture those individual moments in time and keep them forever. Capture a moment in time in a scrapbook page, learn heat embossing with Kelly Purkey, and make a project life double page spread featuring a week in the life of Ali Edwards. A mix of ideas, supplies and designs - all in one Scrapbook Soup!

programme.title: SuperDad
programme.desc: "Xu Wei Hao (Thomas Ong) and Li Zheng Yi (Jeremy Chan) are neighbours who share one thing in common, both men are looked down upon by their wives and children. They receive a mysterious box of chocolates one day, thinking it was a mistake by the post office, Wei Hao and Zheng Yi each took a piece of the chocolate. Zheng Yi, once a cowardly policeman, suddenly possesses superb ability in solving a crime. While Wei Hao regains the respect of his daughter by saving her when she fell from a building. Chen Kai (Chen Han Wei), the ex-husband of Zheng Yi’s wife, was released from jail and tries to seek forgiveness. Seeing his sincerity in turning over a new leaf, Zheng Yi took him in. He accidentally took a piece of the chocolate and discovers its super power. The trio starts to rely on the chocolate every time they needed its super power to solve problems, making them the Super Dad in their children’s eyes. One day, the three fathers see their own children in danger, but there is only one piece of chocolate left. Will they fight to see who gets the last piece of chocolate or will they count on their own will to save their children?"

programme.title: 20 Days
programme.desc: Everyone views singlehood differently. For Edrick ( Elvin Ng) , it is the pain of not being able to find the right girl. As for his brother, Wesley (Nat Ho) , it signifies a life of freedom. Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Incredible Tales Sr 7
programme.desc: Hosted by Utt, Incredible Tales returns for Season 7, featuring more ghoulish stories of paranormal encounters from Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and Philippines. Incredible Tales is all about ghost stories told through generations, crossing boundaries of culture and language. Stories that generate intrigue, fascination, and fear.

programme.title: Crave
programme.desc: Warning: do not watch Crave on an empty stomach. Because we’ll have you craving a creamy scoop of ice cream bedded on a crispy waffle. Or really, really needing to crunch into juicy fried chicken right now. Hosted by Charlotte Mei, the runner-up of Eat List Star, Crave finds out what gets celebrities salivating – roti prata, roast meats, sushi, satay, salted egg ice cream, buah keluak, and even an English-style big breakfast! Our celebrities’ cravings know no bounds, and anything from local to Japanese to Mediterranean fare is fair game – as long as they crave it. And there’s a little special by Charlotte. On every show, she will cook a dish – guaranteed to make you crave for it!

programme.title: Its In Our Nature
programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.desc: A million wildlife species are facing the threat of extinction. But why does this matter to a tiny city state like Singapore? What do we stand to lose if our wildlife go extinct? Host Lam Shushan comes face to face with some of the rarest creatures in the world and meets the tenacious frontliners who are racing to save our native wildlife from extinction.

programme.title: 20 Days

Yet for Edrick’s best friend Jess (Felicia Chin), she simply blames her old-fashioned mother, who forced her to focus on her studies instead.

programme.title: Vettai
programme.desc: "They are part of a special task force assembled to tackle cases pertaining to the Indian community and Indian immigrants. The unit is not widely publicized and their work is kept under wraps. Spearheaded by Chief Dayanidhi, the team consists of three teams and an assigned criminologist. Together they try to tackle cold blooded murders, kidnaps and sexual crimes. But as their professional and personal lives collide, the team is headed towards a perilous outcome. Lives will be lost and bonds will be broken. The pledge that they made to uphold justice and peace in the country that they love will be put to the test. How will they survive? Where does it all lead to? Who is the villain and who is the hero?"

programme.title: Village of the Vampire
programme.desc: Rebecca is searching for her sister, a young journalist who went missing while investigating a series of unfortunate events. The trail leads her to Timere, a remote place far from the hustle and bustle of everyday life, where amidst the tight lipped silence of the town's inhabitants there's an ever growing fear of dark forces at work and no-one dares to leave their home at night. Here Rebecca meets an extravagant writer, the church warden of the town and above all Caleb, a charming, rich and elegant man whose dark gaze hides a chilling secret. It's in this town, where time appears to move between the shadows and danger lurks around every corner that Rebecca learns of the terrible truth and the battle between good and evil begins...

programme.title: Clown Motel
programme.desc: Clown Motel follows a group of ghost hunters, coming from an old ghost town and a bachelorette party, returning home from Las Vegas. When the groups meet up, by mistake, they're left to discover if the motel is really abandoned and haunted by the souls, of the clowns, that once lived there...

programme.title: Demon Baby
programme.desc: A young couple looking to rekindle a damaged relationship retreat to the remote Scottish Highlands. They are haunted by their past, their surroundings and each other.

programme.title: The Last Nosferatu
programme.desc: Ethan has been single for several months and decides to meet people via the Internet. One night, he dates “Black Pearl” whom he literally falls in love with, but she disappears, so he decides to go looking for her. One evening, Black Pearl resurfaces and seems to be hiding a mysterious secret that will lead him to a tragic fate...

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: After his daughter goes missing, a wealthy contractor hires a group of investigative journalists to probe into an abandoned town with hope of uncovering clues about her disappearance...

programme.title: Early Grave
programme.desc: On the eve of their ten year high school reunion, six people are summoned to the isolated country estate of one of their former friends, now a famous horror writer. Once there, separated by guilt, yet bound together by a terrible secret, seven adults try to reconnect with each other, and take stock of their lives. Outside, the storm clouds gather. Rain, lightning and wind isolate the house by washing out the road and knocking down the power lines. And then, they begin to be brutally murdered one by one. Someone is out there in the wind and the rain, someone who has waited for ten years to wreak a terrible vengeance on this group. Seven friends find themselves in a struggle to survive and outwit a diabolical killer who is savagely committed to sending them all to an EARLY GRAVE...

programme.title: Kecksburg
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a mysterious crash and uncovers more than an object, but a massive government conspiracy. Inspired by the real life events of December 9, 1965 and one of America's most mysterious UFO incidents...

programme.title: Witch Trials
programme.desc: Two documentary filmmakers and an ex-cop investigate the disappearance of a young girl that is rumored to have been abducted by a witch in the haunted woods of Connecticut...

programme.title: Ouija Room
programme.desc: An agoraphobic woman with autism begins summoning spirits to be her friends while her brother/caretaker is gone during the day, but the more time she spends with the spirits the more it becomes clear they aren't so friendly after all...

programme.title: Haunted
programme.desc: An aspiring writer pays a visit to his sister to look after her house while she is out of town, but what he finds there is more terrifying than any of the stories he writes...

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: Van Helsing is called upon to help save a missing girl and her friends from a hoard of demons...

programme.title: Cemetery Stories
programme.desc: On Halloween a couple, both of which are clairvoyants, drive to a cemetery. They go for fun to pick up vibrations from the tombstones of the deceased. As they pick up vibrations they have visions of how the person died. Each vibration and vision seems to get darker and darker. In the midst of all of this, they are being stalked by a dark shadowy figure. What starts out as some Halloween fun quickly turns to terror...

programme.title: Groupie
programme.desc: When a mysterious groupie joins legendary cursed band, "The Dark Knights", a series of unexplained murders derails their comeback tour...

programme.title: Mi Sangriento Cumpleaños
programme.desc: Tras un terrible trauma en su cumpleaños, Emma decide no volver a celebrarlo. Pero al cumplir 21, una amiga rompe el ritual con una fiesta sorpresa, sin percatarse del despertar de los horrores que durante años han estado acechando en la oscuridad...

programme.title: La Feria del Diablo
programme.desc: Protagonizada por Justin Duncan, Gerald Crum, Mercedes Peterson y John Charles Dickson. Las estrellas de dos series de televisión paranormales, rivales y enfrentadas, convergen en un parque de atracciones embrujado y abandonado que termina siendo el epicentro del infierno. Ahora están todos atrapados en una guerra sin cuartel contra el mal puro...

programme.title: Naufragio
programme.desc: Mientras transportaba un paquete importante, una joven sufre un accidente de coche en medio de la nada, dejándola atrapada debajo del coche. Poco a poco, se da cuenta de que no solo unos hombres muy malvados la persiguen para recuperar el objeto que transporta, sino que algo muy peligroso la acecha desde las profundidades del bosque...

programme.title: El Juego del Duende
programme.desc: Después de que un hombre adinerado envía a un grupo de ladrones a buscar leyendas urbanas con la intención de abrir un museo lleno de criaturas míticas, pronto descubrirán la leyenda de un duende...

programme.title: Verano Sangriento
programme.desc: Cuatro jóvenes llegan a Mallorca para disfrutar de unas idílicas vacaciones de verano, pero adentrándose en los lugares más inhóspitos de la isla comenzarán un viaje infernal...

programme.title: Juicios de Brujas
programme.desc: Dos realizadores de documentales y un ex policía investigan la desaparición de una niña que se rumorea que fue secuestrada por una bruja en los bosques encantados de Connecticut...

programme.title: Habitación Ouija
programme.desc: Una mujer agorafóbica con autismo comienza a invocar espíritus para que sean sus amigos mientras su hermano/cuidador está ausente durante el día, pero cuanto más tiempo pasa con los espíritus, más claro se vuelve que no son tan amigables después de todo...

programme.title: Serpiente
programme.desc: El equipo de construcción desarrolló a ciegas la isla desconocida, lo que alertó a las dos feroces criaturas de la isla para que fueran destruidas...

programme.title: Recuérdame
programme.desc: Rose despierta en una casa desconocida tras un grave accidente de coche, con pérdida de memoria y sin poder caminar. Su madre y su novio están allí para ayudarla. Rose quiere reconstruir su vida antes del accidente. No todo es lo que parece...

programme.title: La Maldición de la Sirena
programme.desc: Un joven se enamora de una joven seductora y sensual que conoce en la playa. Cuanto más se enamora de ella, más aprende los peligros de enamorarse de una sirena...

programme.title: Aldea del Vampiro
programme.desc: Rebecca busca a su hermana, una joven periodista desaparecida mientras investigaba una serie de desafortunados sucesos. El rastro la conduce a Timere, un lugar remoto alejado del ajetreo de la vida cotidiana, donde entre el hermético silencio de los habitantes del pueblo crece el temor a que actúen fuerzas oscuras y nadie se atreve a salir de casa por la noche. Aquí Rebecca conoce a un extravagante escritor, al guardián de la iglesia del pueblo y, sobre todo, a Caleb, un hombre encantador, rico y elegante cuya oscura mirada esconde un escalofriante secreto. Es en este pueblo, donde el tiempo parece moverse entre las sombras y el peligro acecha en cada esquina, donde Rebecca se entera de la terrible verdad y comienza la batalla entre el bien y el mal...

programme.title: Día del Abandono
programme.desc: Jenny Bilson, una estudiante de último curso de instituto, es la estudiante perfecta, la maravillosa hija de un veterano detective de policía y todo un sueño americano. Pero el único error que no es consciente de haber cometido está a punto de perseguirla de una forma muy violenta, cuando su pasado regresa en busca de venganza...

programme.title: Isla Pitón
programme.desc: Un grupo de personas que buscan un árbol mágico en una selva misteriosa descubren que no están solos. Algo los observa, esperando el momento perfecto para atacar...

programme.title: Jack y Jill: Las Colinas del Infierno
programme.desc: Tras buscar a su hija desaparecida, una dama y su grupo de búsqueda descubren la leyenda que se esconde tras la pareja asesina de Jack y Jill...

programme.title: Atrapado Por Su Pasado
programme.desc: Rodolfo, sicario renombrado, debe cuidar a su hijo mientras su pasado criminal amenaza su vida.

programme.title: Doble Personalidad
programme.desc: Un agente se infiltra en trata de personas y juegos clandestinos para salvar victimas y capturar culpables.

programme.title: Cannabis Land
programme.desc: Conocido como H1, busca formar un nuevo grupo y ganarse el respeto en la organizacion del negocio.

programme.title: El Consejo de un Padre
programme.desc: Un joven campesino entra a la mafia pese a la advertencia de su padre para evitar la muerte o la prision.

programme.title: Brillando en la Oscuridad
programme.desc: Dos hombres devastados buscan paz interior en Jalcomulco tras la perdida de seres queridos y traicion.

programme.title: Duenos de la Plaza
programme.desc: Dos narcos rivales luchan por la plaza tras perder Luz en una carrera, mientras su hijo aprende el negocio.

programme.title: El Pirata
programme.desc: Un hombre pierde un ojo en una partida de poker y busca vengarse de quienes lo traicionaron.

programme.title: Barrio de Narcos
programme.desc: Dos policias honestos luchan por desenmascarar al que controla el poder en un barrio sin ley

programme.title: Charlando Con La Muerte
programme.desc: La familia Rodas enfrenta a extorsionadores y el padre lucha contra la banda arriesgando su vida.

programme.title: Comando Suicidia
programme.desc: Killer el R recluta a sicarios peligrosos para ejecutar a un capo, enfrentando sus propias rivalidades.

programme.title: El Nino Sicario
programme.desc: Abandonado de nino, sobrevive en la calle y se une al crimen organizado en esta esperada pelicula.

programme.title: El Nuevo Narcotraficante
programme.desc: Octavio entra al narcotrafico y lucha por poder, enfrentando a su exjefe en una batalla sin limites.

programme.title: El Regreso del 24
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su hermana, el 24 sale de su retiro y busca venganza sin limites.

programme.title: El Ultimo Cartucho
programme.desc: Dos hermanos pistoleros luchan para proteger a una tribu de nativos y sus tierras.

programme.title: El Desertor
programme.desc: Luego de ser reclutado para el servicio militar y ante los abusos de su jefe inmediato, el Subteniente Montilla, Julián escapa del cuartel, lo que provoca una feroz persecución por parte de Montilla, quien se ha enamorado de Sagrario y hará todo lo posible para separar a los jóvenes.

programme.title: El Tercer Deseo
programme.desc: Eugenio, un corredor de bienes raíces despierta en una esquina de la ciudad con una descomunal borrachera y descubre cerca una desportillada tetera de metal. La toma y manosea a ver si es de plata y, de pronto, se le aparece el espectro de un duende que le sugiere formule tres deseos. El genio desaparece sin dar oportunidad al tercer deseo. Mas tarde, descubre que los deseos le han sido concedidos pero de forma equivocada. La vida de Eugenio se complica, solo anhela reencontrar la tetera abandonada y pedir el tercer deseo.

programme.title: El Retorno
programme.desc: Una extraña mujer mantiene expectante y desorientado al espectador cuando a diario habla con su hija y la presencia de su hija no aparece en ningún momento. Una historia no previsible que juega al despiste, por lo que, hay que esperar hasta el final para saber lo que está pasando la protagonista.

programme.title: ¡Ni Te Me Acerques!
programme.desc: Él solo tenía que cuidar el hotel y teclear su novela, como Jack Nicholson en “El Resplandor”, pero de buen rollo. Y Llega la cuarentena y se queda le pilla en el Hotel Balneario de Ariño haciendo frente a la paranoia general, el acoso de las fuerzas del orden, las videollamadas de su novia, su madre y del conspiranoico Javi... Todos nos aburrimos mucho en el primer confinamiento. Juan no.

programme.title: El Secuestro
programme.desc: Un joven con talento en la música sueña con ser un gran artista hasta que conoce al hijo de un poderoso narcotraficante colombiano quién promete ayudarlo a cambio de que trabaje para ellos. El joven no se imagina en que mundo se está metiendo. La fama le costará lo que más ama.

programme.title: El Duende
programme.desc: Rosalía se muda a la ciudad junto a su hijo pequeño, Ramiro. Con la ayuda de una conocida, consigue encontrar vivienda. La casa ha estado cerrada por décadas, y tiene un horno antiguo. Lo que Rosalía ignora es que dentro del horno habita un duende que tiene por costumbre robar niños.

programme.title: 4 Metros
programme.desc: 4 METROS relata, en tono de comedia romántica, la historia de un hombre entrando en la crisis de los 40. Joaquín tiene un zumbido en los oídos y poco sabe de sí mismo. Se ha dejado llevar sin intervenir demasiado en sus deseos. No escucha su voz interior. Su vida afectiva y laboral no tienen rumbo. El zumbido quizá sea la expresión, no asumida ni entendida todavía, de un ruido metafórico de la vida gritándole por dónde ir. Su novia tiene 20 años menos, aparece la presión social y familiar sobre la paternidad, sentirse útil, la vocación, el trabajo y cómo ser feliz. Hasta que otra mujer irrumpe y todo parece acomodarse. Pero siempre el orden debe ser interno. Así, como si el destino tomara la palabra, su vida cambiará 4 metros abajo del agua, donde aparece un sendero para encontrar la identidad.

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: Baile Peligroso
programme.desc: Miluska es una cantante, que se gana la vida haciendo shows musicales para un hotel turístico en el sur de Perú. Durante las presentaciones conoce una variedad de empresarios de todo nivel, entre ellos está Don Mauro, un señor respetable, que admira mucho a Miluska, Carlos Reyes, un traficante de mujeres que se hace pasar por empresario. Al ser cliente frecuente del hotel se gana cierta confianza con las chicas, un día le ofrece a Miluska hacer un show para su hotel en otra provincia, pero no sabían que caerían en una trampa difícil de escapar.

programme.title: Codón Es Una Máquina
programme.desc: Dos amigos se reúnen para planear la creación de una película con un equipo de producción filmando el proceso, dos cuarentones con problemitas están muy decididos a hacer la famosa película de la que llevan años hablando. Se vienen tan arriba que hasta ya graban el making of... y hasta están haciendo un casting, aunque no tienen ni guión ni puñetera idea de lo que van a rodar. Y lo peor: no sospechan que están en las manos de un loco peligroso.

programme.title: El Mariachi Gringo
programme.desc: Comedia romántica sobre un joven de la América profunda que -tras tener como improvisado maestro de guitarra a un emigrante- viaja a México huyendo de su vida tediosa y de su familia, para ejercitarse como mariachi.

programme.title: Canon: Fidelidad al Límite
programme.desc: Mariana de 35 años, es una arquitecta que trabaja y es socia de un importante despacho de arquitectos, está casada con Julián de 40 años, quien es corresponsal de guerra. Está enamorados, felices, con relación sexual cotidiana. Son padre de dos hijos de 14 y 17 año. En el juego sexual, Julián menciona que no le importaría la infidelidad a condición de estar enterado del hecho con detalles.

programme.title: Bendita Calamidad
programme.desc: Los hermanos Fayos, Anselmo y Ricardo, están con el agua al cuello. Su bar no funciona, el Ayuntamiento lo clausura y se ha agotado el dinero que, para ir tirando, solicitaron a unos prestamistas que no se andan con contemplaciones a la hora de cobrar. Piden consejo a un abogado poco amigo de la ley, Antonio Orestes, que les sugiere una vía rápida para acabar con sus problemas: El secuestro exprés de un constructor de Tarazona.

programme.title: Soy Una Buena Persona
programme.desc: Sabina es una treintañera muy "artista" convencida de que podrá algún día vivir de su arte como diseñadora, actriz, guionista o directora, porque ella está destinada a petarlo. Mientras, como casi toda su generación, malvive gorroneando en casa de sus padres. Pero una noche tiene, por desgracia ajena, una oportunidad de lujo... y no dudará en aprovecharla sin pensárselo demasiado.

programme.title: La Sangre Iluminada
programme.desc: Seis personajes explican su compleja existencia entrelazada. Cada cierto tiempo, debido a matemáticas inexplicables, la vida de estos personajes cambia y ocupan el cuerpo de otro

programme.title: Inquebrantable
programme.desc: Lupita vive en Ciudad Juárez con su hija Margarita, el esposo de Margarita es un alcohólico, mujeriego, y golpeador, la hija de Lupita, Margarita va a la universidad pero desde niña tiene una enfermedad de un mal cardiaco causado por la violencia domestica que ha sufrido desde niña, el doctor Villa le comenta a Lupita que Margarita su hija va a morir si no tiene un donante de corazón, desesperada ella se pone a vender cualquier cosa de valor que tenga en su casa para comprar el corazón en el mercado negro.

programme.title: Vecinos del Terror
programme.desc: Por accidente se les dispara un arma con el impacto matan al cuñado quien después regresa de ultratumba a cobrar venganza y ni la policía se escapa de la venganza de ultratumba

programme.title: Los Siete Sellos de la Santa Muerte
programme.desc: Una serie de extraños asesinatos están ocurriendo en la ciudad. Una investigadora de lo paranormal y un detective privado se dedican a indagar en el caso y lo que encontraran será algo que nunca imaginaron.

programme.title: Expediente 53 2.0
programme.desc: Mientras el líder de los delincuentes de la ciudad, Jack se reúne con el demonio Lilly alias Abal en un antro/table para matar y tomar las almas de sus víctimas. El FBI pide ayuda de unos sacerdotes solo que el hermano menor de Jack es poseído por Abal y ahora Jack tendrá que tomar una de las decisiones más difíciles de su vida.

programme.title: Buenas Noches, Dijo La Señorita Pájaro
programme.desc: Un adulterio, un secreto familiar, un asesino en serie. Una historia fabricada con estructura de muñecas rusas y con ritmo de montañas rusas.

programme.title: El Director (Las Siete Madres de Edipo)
programme.desc: Dos jóvenes estudiantes de actuación siguiendo sus sueños se embarcan en un proyecto para filmar una película de terror que no resulta ser lo que esperaban.

programme.title: Los Siete Sellos de la Santa Muerte 2
programme.desc: Después de desmantelar a una poderosa secta los misteriosos crímenes continúan y la policía se dedica a investigar quien es el nuevo líder de la organización para atraparlo y acabar con la violencia.

programme.title: La Mujer que Hablaba con Los Muertos
programme.desc: Es un film de Terror. Cuando Elena Castaño era una niña, tenía un don: era capaz de comunicarse con los espíritus de los muertos. pero esa capacidad desapareció al crecer.

programme.title: Expediente 53 3.0
programme.desc: Un extraño ser del más allá regresa con sed de venganza para acabar con todas las personas que lo han estado atormentando por todos estos años, decidiendo poseer a Jack y darle más fuerza a Baal.

programme.title: El Cóndor En Nueva York
programme.desc: Un narcotraficante de Nueva York, llamado Damián, ha creado una nueva droga con efectos impactantes.

programme.title: Amateur
programme.desc: Martín, es un editor que trabaja en un canal de televisión cuyo dueño es el señor Battaglia.

programme.desc: Wake up with a breathing exercise, then strengthen your abs and thighs. Give your spine a full stretch as you roll into a ball.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: In an Imaginary Chair, that is! You’ll feel your thighs strengthening by the second. Camel Pose will stretch your body inside and out from knees to chin.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Breathing awareness techniques and neck exercises help relieve stress and built-up tension.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Salute to the Sun, Shoulderstand, Fish, and other asanas bend, stretch, and strengthen your entire body.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Don’t let a weak back hold you back. Strengthen it!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Increase the range of motion in these important areas of the body.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Invigorate body and mind with a great head-to-toe stretch as you reach for the sky and BREATHE!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Learn the art of breathing to keep your lungs strong and your mind sharp.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: An ancient practice for cleansing the nose and sinuses to prevent colds and other respiratory ailments. Good for allergies, too.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Stretch your spine up and down, forward and back; roll on it, twist it, and strengthen it. Don’t worry—it’s safe and fun!

programme.title: The Lion and the Mouse
programme.desc: Inspired by an Aesop Fable and the moral and spiritual values of yoga, the characters of this exciting action-packed romp will have kids on the edge of their seats—sometimes laughing, sometimes tearing up—as our heroes try to overcome the challenges before them.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana shows how backbending poses improve posture and increase energy. The session ends with deep, nerve-soothing Yoga Nidra relaxation.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana demonstrates how to loosen joints and strengthen limbs, abs, and buttocks. She introduces Cobra, an exercise that stretches internal organs.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Reverse Arrow restores energy and improves circulation. Rock and Roll tones the spine and gets those abs working.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: A series of forward and backbending asanas loosens, strengthens, and tones the spine. Roaring like a lion keeps the respiratory tract healthy.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: This breathing technique calms nerves and purifies and oxygenates the blood.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: The Cat Stretch teaches hip movement and gives a flexible spine. The Fish (and other asanas) strengthens the spine and opens the chest, allowing deeper breathing.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Balancing on buttocks helps to stretch the hamstrings. Tiger Pose tones the buttocks. Sitting in an Imaginary Chair strengthens thigh muscles—fast!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana demonstrates an asana to strengthen the arms and stretch the whole body. Then a variety of poses work the abs and stretch the hamstrings.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana explains how cleansing the sinuses with warm water and salt can result in fewer colds and sinus infections.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana demonstrates poses that soothe the nerves and stretch and twist the spine.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Diving Pose strengthens the back and thighs and gets the heart pumping. Wrapping the body into a little ball offers a good spinal stretch, while Tree Pose improves balance.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: This simple but powerful exercise concentrates energy at the navel chakra, increasing strength and vitality. Wai Lana also demonstrates ways to strengthen and loosen joints, improve balance, and twist and bend backwards.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Headstand is best learned step by step, with the aid of a wall. Boat strengthens abs, Locust strengthens the spine, and Easy Wheel works on arms, thighs, and buttocks.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Rock and roll, then twist about to wake up the spine and keep the internal organs happy. Then relax with a meditation that deepens the breath and calms the mind.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana demonstrates two ab strengtheners for a firm, flat tummy. Two versions of Plough offer maximum stretch in the spine and hamstrings. A good leg stretch twist, too!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Roaring like a lion strengthens the vocal cords and massages the thyroid and facial muscles. It’s good for skin care, too!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: This dynamic version of Cobra strengthens arms and tones the back. Wai Lana also does some upside down poses, including Headstand.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: No need to worry if tendons pop and crack during poses that exercise the joints from toes to fingertips. It’s a good sign!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana starts off with an invigorating stretch and breathing exercise. She then introduces an easy way to do the Plough.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: This series includes forward and back bends, spinal twists, and balancing poses. You’ll balance on one leg, and on your buttocks!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Wai Lana shows how a cloth helps open tight shoulders, preparing for an asana that strengthens your lungs and allows full breathing. Good ab and arm strengtheners here, too!

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: Lots of bending poses—forward and back, up and down—will make your spine strong and flexible. You’ll also tone your buttocks and thighs.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga
programme.desc: A single pose stretches hamstrings, stimulates the spine, and opens the shoulders. A simple exercise, which can be done anywhere, relieves built-up tension in the neck and shoulders.

programme.title: Wai Lana Yoga

programme.desc: The world's best polo teams meet at the Dubai Polo Gold Cup competition. They will have to show a combination of equestrian pursuits, skills and team effort to win. Relive the 2020 final between UAE vs. AM.

programme.title: Sunshine Tour - Week 5
programme.desc: The fifth week of the Sunshine Tour 2020 is running short due to the COVID-19 pandemic, but the exciting past weeks of the competition are not over until the Suzuki Grand Prix is disputed. In the last day of the XXVI Sunshine Tour, both riders and horses enjoyed a wonderful competition, and the best riders have made it to the jumpoff. Enjoy the best moments of the fifth week of the Sunshine Tour, on HorseTV.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Mexico - HL
CHI de Genève - Best Moments
programme.desc: The 59th edition of the CHI de Genève is about to take place at the Palexpo Geneva. The top riders are ready for one of Europe's most demanding courses. They have at stake the Rolex Grand Slam of Show Jumping and a spot at the hall of fame. Relive the best moments of the 2019 edition of the CHI de Genève.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 2
programme.desc: Get ready for a ride with us in this new episode of Horse Academy Pro! This time, Rolf Göran-Bengtsson will be teaching us how to make proper turns and students will be practicing jumps in a closed circuit with their horses. They will be increasing the height as students get better, will they be capable to adapt quickly to Bengtsson's teachings? Find it out on this exclusive show on HorseTV.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Episode 5 - Saint Tropez
programme.desc: We move on to sunny Saint Tropez to celebrate the fifth leg of the Longines Global Champions Tour 2022. Who will win Saint Tropez's GP?

Arte Equestre TV - Episode 1 - Italian Cowboy Dressage Championship 2021
programme.desc: After several years without an event, Uaipre decided to organize the Italian Cowboy Dressage Championship 2021, and for the surprise of many, it was a huge success. The time needed to organize the event was very limited due to changes in organization, but the will and compromise of all organisers saw outstanding performances from the Italian cowboy dressage riders. We participate in the event and interview both organizers and participants to grasp their overall impressions.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 2: Stories from the Stud
programme.desc: This week Ride seeks out the scorching sands of Kuwait where the Arabian Horse reigns supreme, skims the surf on the Emerald Isle with the Connemara Ponies of Cashel Bay Stud and recognises the dressage stars of the future at the home of Germany’s Olympic Gold Medalist Sonke Rothenberger.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 3: Horses & Heritage
programme.desc: This week Ride travels back in time on the UK’s waterways aboard one of the last remaining horse drawn Barges. programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Episode 5 - Saint Tropez

Who will win Saint Tropez's GP?

programme.title: Global Champions League - Episode 5 - Saint Tropez
The Polo Show - Episode 5
programme.desc: Today we will share with you some of the highlights of some of the best Women's Tournaments of 2019. We went to Florida to enjoy the US Open Women's Championship, across the Atlantic to England for the Staple International between England and Argentina, over to France where we stopped in Saint-Tropez for the Women's International and in Chantilly for the Women's French Open. Then back over to Argentina to enjoy the Pink Polo at Thai Polo Club.

programme.title: CHIO Aachen - Best Moments
programme.desc: Words speak for themselves. An equestrian show unrivalled anywhere in the world, offering the highest level of performance. The CHIO Aachen is probably the most prestigious horse show in Europe when it comes to show jumping and dressage. Riders compete against each other in this episode for victory in the show jumping competition. Relive all the magic moments of the 2019 edition of the CHIO Aachen.

programme.title: Jumping International Le Saut Hermès - Highlights Prix du 24 Faubourg
programme.desc: After the famous Le Saut Hermès, the Prix du 24 Faubourg is also a competition with a classification of CSI5* but this time with point accumulation and against the clock. With obstacles from 1.50m to 1.60m, it is a big challenge with a progressive difficulty as rider and horse advance on the course. Relive the best moments of the Prix du 24 Faubourg in its 2019 edition.

programme.title: Longines FEI Jumping Nations Cup - Mexico - HL
CHI de Genève - Best Moments
programme.desc: The 59th edition of the CHI de Genève is about to take place at the Palexpo Geneva. The top riders are ready for one of Europe's most demanding courses. They have at stake the Rolex Grand Slam of Show Jumping and a spot at the hall of fame. Relive the best moments of the 2019 edition of the CHI de Genève.

programme.title: Horse Academy Pro - Chapter 2
programme.desc: Get ready for a ride with us in this new episode of Horse Academy Pro! This time, Rolf Göran-Bengtsson will be teaching us how to make proper turns and students will be practicing jumps in a closed circuit with their horses. They will be increasing the height as students get better, will they be capable to adapt quickly to Bengtsson's teachings? Find it out on this exclusive show on HorseTV.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 4: Horsewomen
programme.desc: This week Ride celebrates three extraordinary horsewomen and the captivating connection they have with their equine friends. We showcase exhebition work from American dressage star Sabine Schut-Kery, experience life through a lens with Poland’s fine art horse photographer Katarzyna Okrzesik-Mikolajek, and witness the holistic approach to healing in South West England with renowned trainer Connie Cox.

programme.title: FEI Rides Magazine - Episode 5: Heroes & Healers
programme.desc: This week Ride exercises military precision with the mounts of the Household Cavalry at the British Army’s London Barracks, and sees second chances given to troubled residents at Achterhoek horse shelter in the Netherlands. We’re in the back seat with Polish driving expert Piotr Mazurek and catch up with this year’s Longines FEI Rising Star Award winner, Germany’s Greta Busacker.

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN as we reveal how a drop of crude oil transforms into our clothes, uncovering a complex and fascinating journey of the textile and garment manufacturing process. Follow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

programme.title: Meet China: From Little Toys to Global Factories, How Chinese Creativity Travels
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how “Made in China” is taking on new forms. A monster toy becomes a global collectible, an ocean park in southern China turns wonder into repeat visits, and a smart EV factory in Zhejiang shows how cars are built for overseas markets. In central China’s Xuchang, a small city supplies much of the world’s hair products, while in Guangxi, an Italian chef blends pizza with traditional medicinal food. From blind boxes to electric vehicles, wigs and a yam-and-lamb pizza, this episode reveals how Chinese creativity, scale and culture are reaching the world in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Follow the Money: Where Climate Capital Is Going
programme.desc: Clean energy investment has surpassed fossil fuel supply investment, signaling a fundamental shift in how markets address climate risk. Capital is accelerating into renewables, electrification, and industrial decarbonization—but how do we ensure these funds drive climate action? CGTN's Guan Xin moderates a panel at the 2026 Summer Davos Forum, bringing together voices from government, business, and international institutions to explore the trends, challenges, and prospects of climate capital allocation. Tune in to find out where climate capital is flowing and explore the opportunities in the green transition.#SummerDavos2026

programme.title: BizTalk | Summer Davos special: New opportunities for growth in China
programme.desc: The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as Summer Davos, is underway in Dalian. During the forum, China’s technological innovation, green development and business environment have once again become key topics of discussion. In this special episode of BizTalk, CGTN speaks with Liu Zhenmin, China’s special envoy for climate change, Joe Ngai, chairman of McKinsey Greater China, and Leo Lee, president of Novartis China, to explore how China is cultivating new growth drivers amid a new wave of industrial transformation, and why “the next China is still China”.

programme.title: SABOREANDO CHINA
programme.desc: Aprenda a preparar las recetas más populares de China. Nuestro chef le revelará de forma práctica los secretos del arte culinario de esta nación asiática. Conozca los ingredientes más utilizados en la variada cocina regional, los orígenes de los platos e incluso sus beneficios para la salud. En De China a tu cocina, el espectador podrá experimentar a la vez la riqueza tradicional y la variedad gastronómica de China.

programme.title: NIHAO CHINA
programme.desc: Es la clase de chino de CGTN-Español. Las series “Aprendamos juntos pinyin”, “Comunícate en chino” y “Viajando y aprendiendo chino”, abordan diferentes niveles de aprendizaje de la nueva lengua de moda en el mundo, brindando así a los televidentes la posibilidad de ampliar su vocabulario, mejorar su gramática y dominar las frases y expresiones más usuales del idioma con más hablantes en el planeta.

programme.desc: Descubre para el televidente el gran legado cultural e histórico de las distintas regiones y etnias de China. programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, we continue our journey along the Xiangjiang River in Hunan Province, traveling to the cities of Zhuzhou and Xiangtan to meet another group of extraordinary women. By capturing snippets of the lives and work of an electric locomotive designer, a flight instructor, a painter, and a poverty alleviation volunteer, we showcase the unique cultural and humanistic charm of this region.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.1: Old Gems
programme.desc: Xiamen, a key starting point of China’s ancient Maritime Silk Road, is one of China’s most livable cities. In this episode, host Min-Zhui Lee and co-host Pan William, an honorary citizen of Xiamen and a professor, take you on an immersive journey through the city. Explore Xiamen University, renowned as China’s most beautiful university campus, and visit Wanshi Park, known as “China’s First Lawn”. Trace Xiamen’s history through its streets, admiring the arcades that tell the stories of the city’s early commercial development. Finally, board a boat to Gulangyu Islet, the “Island of Music” — the birthplace of modern music education in China, and a living “World Architecture Museum”. Every corner of this islet lets you experience the past and present of Xiamen’s vibrant life.

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.1
programme.desc: Tianran and Hannah climb Mount.Huangshan, one of China's most famous mountains, sampling its delicate green tea and the rich flavors of Anhui cuisine, and explore the region's ancient villages and lush bamboo forests featured in the blockbuster film "Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon".

programme.title: Foodwise: Huangshan Ep.2
programme.desc: In Huangshan, Anhui Province, the hosts enjoy a cup of Queen Elizabeth II's favorite tea, as well as the oldest green tea to be exported Europe, and get hands on with quirky local delicacies ranging from "word candy" and tofu made of leaves, to the downright funky flavors of hairy tofu and stinky mandarin fish.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.3
programme.desc: Hainan- the anchor-point of China's southern frontier, its islands custodians of the vast South China Sea! And perhaps nothing embodies the allure of the oceanic wonderland more than the limpid waters of Sansha. From volcanic northern shores to cutting-edge modern cities, join us on coastal journey dotted with historic lighthouses illuminating a fascinating past and guiding the way to a promising future...

programme.title: Exploring Beijing’s Backyard
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore the beautiful scenery of Beijing suburbs which is usually ignored by the public. Through self-driving tour, the representative tourism resources in the north of Beijing: Yanqing, Huairou and Miyun are involved, from the scenic spots, food to accommodation. The contents include "Mini Three Gorges" Longqing Valley, "Unique Water Great Wall": Huanghuacheng and "Northern Jiangnan" : Gubei Water Town.

programme.title: Shunde’s Waterways: where business smarts meet everyday life
programme.desc: Shunde, a district in Guangdong Province, lies in the Pearl River Delta, north of Hong Kong—a water-rich region that lives by water and knows how to turn it into opportunity. Once, boats carried silk down its canals from small villages, building a legacy of trade. Today, Xiangyunsha (gambiered Canton gauze) is a global fashion icon, and historic spots like Mingshi Garden draw tourists and locals alike. With water as their muse and grit as their guide, Shunde folks keep business thriving while making life sweeter—that’s the quiet wisdom flowing through their rivers. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia are setting out to explore more with the locals...

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates. Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training hard for the arena. Together, their stories reveal Shaolin kung fu’s enduring pull, one that crosses cultures and borders while uniting practitioners through tradition, discipline, and self-mastery.

programme.title: Celadon Ou Music
programme.desc: Celadon ou music is also called "bowl music.” The reason is that the ancient Chinese word for bowl sounds like ou. The music originated simply as improvised rhythms tapped out on bowls. It was this spontaneity that made celadon ou so popular. Celadon ou music was at the height of its popularity over 1,100 years ago. But with time, it faded from history. At one point, it was even on the verge of being lost forever. After hundreds of years of obscurity, it re-emerged at the end of last century.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals. The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a place where classical martial arts find new life and cross-cultural practices thrive.

programme.title: Yangliuqing New Year Painting Art
programme.desc: On May 20, 2006, Yangliuqing New Year Paintings were named as part of China’s national intangible cultural heritage. The New Year painting tradition can be traced back many centuries, to the Ming Dynasty and beyond, reaching the height of its popularity in the Qing Dynasty. There are no restrictions on the themes of the paintings, and there is no blessing they cannot convey. Yangliuqing New Year Paintings are loved all over the country for their beautiful details and vivid colors—but most of all, for the good wishes they impart to anyone who sees them.

programme.title: Women of the Xiangjiang River Ep.4
programme.desc: In this episode, we arrive in Changsha — the economic and cultural hub of Hunan Province, and a core city in the Yangtze River Middle Reaches Economic Zone. Our lens turns to the "Xiangjiang Ladies" who work in Changsha’s high-tech and equipment manufacturing sectors. Their daily lives and professional endeavors reflect the city’s innovative vitality, while their after-work gatherings also showcase the dazzling night views along both banks of the Xiangjiang River, highlighting Changsha’s distinct charm as a vibrant capital of leisure and entertainment.

programme.title: Enchanting Xiamen Ep.2: New Jewels
programme.desc: In the second episode of our Xiamen series, host Tianran He and co-host Laura, an American who has lived in Xiamen for 7 years, guide you to discover Xiamen's internationalization, modernization, and unique fashion vibe. First, they cycle along the island road, taking in the stunning coastal scenery of the famous Round-the-Island Road, and step into Zengcuoan — once a small fishing village, now a thriving creative hub — to showcase its remarkable transformation. Next, Laura leads Tianran to experience the daily life of expats in Xiamen: exploring the lively coffee bar street, and joining a fun gathering at a stylish French restaurant. A passionate lover of Chinese culture, Laura invites Tianran to experience a traditional Chinese tea ceremony. After that, the pair head to Xiamen’s fashion central business district, experimenting with bold new looks in clothing stores that have caught the eye of the global fashion community. Finally, Tianran visits an egret habitat to meet photographers who document these beautiful birds, and together they admire the grace of Xiamen's iconic egrets.

programme.title: Shunde's flavors: where tradition blends with vivid daily life
programme.desc: Shunde, a gastronomic gem in the Pearl River Delta, neighboring Hong Kong, uses masterful craft and sincere heart to transform local treasures – from crispy fish skin to fried milk – into culinary wonders. Now, two friends, Julian Waghann from the United States and Absalom Absalom from Namibia, are setting out to taste the flavors and feel the warmth of Shunde's countryside with the locals.

programme.title: Foodwise: Fuding
programme.desc: The hosts are in Fuding, Fujian Province in southeast China for the Dragon Boat Festival, where teams of rowers compete against each other in narrow dragon-shaped boats. From making and eating zongzi rice dumplings to trying local street food, the hosts take part in the festivities before exploring the world of white tea, from visiting its “mother tree” to drinking it in a zen temple, and even feasting on a white tea banquet!

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuyi Mountains
programme.desc: The hosts are in the Wuyi Mountains of Fujian Province, the birthplace of oolong tea. Here they enjoy tea ceremony on a bamboo raft, feast on everything from smoked goose to lotus seed soup, and explore an ancient town that once sold tea to Russia. They discover that here it’s all about terroir, and that nestled within the cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains is the most expensive tea in the world.

programme.title: Bird's-eye China Ep.4
programme.desc: Shaanxi, almost right in the middle of China, is a true land of contrasts. South of the Qinling Mountains that divide the province, the terrain has all the allure of south China, while north of this great dividing range lies the Guanzhong Plain and the austere and otherworldly Loess Plateau. Join us for a journey into a province that presents two equally beautiful and fascinating faces to the world!

programme.title: As Chill as the Pandas in Sichuan
programme.desc: Why are pandas so chill? CGTN's Ioana heads to Sichuan to find out, embarking on a journey that's as bashi (effortlessly satisfying) as it is unforgettable. The documentary "As Chill as the Pandas in Sichuan" invites you to slow down, tune in, and discover what it truly means to live a bashi life.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Colors of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In the first episode of our Sichuan Daliang Mountains series, we journey to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province. Setting off from Xichang, the prefectural capital, we first explore Lizhou Ancient Town, the southern gateway of the Southern Silk Road. We then travel to Huili County in the southernmost part of the Daliang Mountains, where we listen to the morning bells and evening drums, try our hand at making green pottery, and pick fresh pomegranates. Finally, we head to the western part of the Greater Liangshan Mountains and step into the mysterious Lugu Lake. We visit a Mosuo family to learn about their unique culture and take part in one of the Mosuo people’s most important rituals: the coming?of?age ceremony.

programme.title: Elvis & Madona
programme.desc: Elvis & Madona is a romantic comedy that deals with an unusual subject in a delicate and realistic way: a love story between young lesbian Elvis and a transvestite Madona. The story takes place in Copacabana, neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro. The screenplay comprehends a full array of human types and, by following the journey of both protagonists, illustrates the conflicts generated by the evolution of behavior and custom. It is a modern and agile picture, and its soundtrack will follow the latest musical trends. Nevertheless, it is essentially a love story, proving that love can exist in any situation.

programme.title: Catching A Wave
programme.desc: This program follows the joint China-Vietnam coast guard fleet in the Beibu Gulf as they conduct patrols and search-and-rescue drills. It also documents the 27th joint law enforcement and fisheries patrol, and the challenges faced by ASEAN countries in promoting the establishment of a Code of Conduct in the South China Sea.

programme.title: Zero Hour 1
programme.desc: As China sets its sights on achieving carbon neutrality by 2060, young people across the country are looking for creative solutions to help reach that goal. At Tsinghua University, students are learning to become stewards of the planet through research, policymaking, and storytelling. Meanwhile, students in Shenzhen have developed new methods for collecting and using rainwater, innovative grass-planting methods in Inner Mongolia are making China's deserts more habitable, and renewable energy is gradually replacing traditional energy sources. Perhaps the dream of carbon neutrality is closer than we thought.

programme.desc: In the season premiere, Dr. David Behm explores the science of elite athletic performance. From lab insights to real-world training with NHL pros and coach Ben Prentiss, we discover how peak performance shapes health and everyday strength.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E02 - Blue Mind (Part 1)
programme.desc: In this episode set in scenic New Zealand, we explore the deep-rooted question: Does being near or in water actually improve our health? Guided by Dr. Wallace J. Nichols, author of "The Blue Mind," we delve into the scientific and emotional benefits of water, exemplified by therapeutic surfing experiences and the Maori people's ancestral connection to aquatic environments. From mental well-being to physical health, we uncover how New Zealand's abundant waters serve as more than just a natural spectacle; they are a source of holistic health and well-being. Along the way, Dr. Nichols introduces the concept of a "bluescription," a personalized prescription for water-based activities, inviting viewers to tap into the transformative power of water in their own lives.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E04 - Mindfulness (Part 1)
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E06 - Happiness (Part 1)
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E08 - The Purpose of life Pt 1
programme.desc: Have you ever hiked with all five senses? Join us on a journey from the bustling metropolis of Tokyo to the serene Okutama forest to meet Dr. Kagawa, the pioneering scientist who first validated the health benefits of nature immersion. Together, we engage in Shinrin Yoku, commonly known as forest bathing, a sensory-rich experience that invites us to use all five senses as we explore the wooded landscape. This episode reveals that forest bathing is far more than just a nature hike; it's a practice of mindfulness that fully immerses us in the present moment through sight, sound, smell, touch, and taste. Learn how this deeply rooted Japanese tradition offers both physical and psychological benefits, opening your mind and tuning your senses to the therapeutic powers of nature. Join us on this eye-opening expedition and discover how you, too, can improve your well-being through the simple yet transformative act of forest bathing.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E09 - Purpose Of Life (Part 2)
programme.desc: We travel to the Japanese island known for having some of the oldest people on Earth. We engage with leading scientists who have identified the "Longevity Gene," offering a glimpse into the genetic factors that contribute to extended lifespans. Beyond genetics, we explore the deeply ingrained cultural practices that sustain long, fulfilling lives in Okinawa. We delve into the importance of "moai," a lifelong social network that supports residents into their golden years, and the principle of "Hara Hachi Bu," which advises eating until you're 80% full while focusing on nourishing foods. But at the core of Okinawan longevity, we find "ikigai"—a profound sense of life purpose. From practicing martial arts to active community participation, we discover that Okinawan seniors maintain a vibrant sense of purpose in various facets of life. Join us on this enlightening journey to learn how the pillars of social support, mindful eating, and a strong sense of ikigai could enhance your own quest for a long and fulfilling life.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E10 - Way Of The Forest

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E11 - Harvesting Health
programme.desc: After witnessing agricultural practices in far-flung places like Bhutan and Okinawa, host Mike dives into the world of sustainable gardening right in his own backyard. With the guidance of a local soil scientist, we follow Mike's hands-on journey into the art and science of farming sustainably. From planting the first seeds to navigating unexpected challenges, this episode offers a candid look at the highs and lows of gardening for sustainability. Beyond the physical labor and the harvest, we also explore the emotional and mental rewards of this earthy endeavor. Mike learns that the act of growing your own food is not just a means to an end—it's a therapeutic practice that nurtures the mind as well as the body. Tune in to see how the simple act of cultivating a garden can yield abundant lessons in sustainability, health, and well-being.

programme.title: Health Explored S01 E12 - Behind Season 1
programme.desc: We embark on a unique journey around the world to film our series but behind the scenes explore the effects of stress on the human body. Equipped with cutting-edge Hexo Skin sensors and other wearable tech, we subject ourselves to adrenaline-pumping activities like skydiving and roller coaster rides, as well as draining experiences like red-eye flights. By monitoring real-time data, we gain fascinating insights into how various stressors impact our physiological responses. From heart rate fluctuations to sleep monitoring this episode reveals how stress can be both an exhilarating and exhausting experience. As we push the limits of adventure—and our own comfort zones—we discover that creating a health series can be a surprisingly stressful endeavor in itself. Tune in to uncover the multifaceted impact of stress on our well-being and learn what we can do to manage it effectively.

programme.desc: The World Poker Tour returns to Playground Poker Club in Montreal, Quebec, Canada, and 732 players compete for their share of the more than $2 million prize pool.
